note: Accepted findings from scripts/checks/scan.mjs. Every entry needs a written reason. An entry matches when all of its present fields match a finding: `file` (glob, repo-relative, forward slashes), `rule` (rule id from security/patterns.json), `fingerprint` (from the scan report). Prefer the narrowest entry that works. Allowlisting a `secret`-severity rule should be rare and is a deliberate decision. See docs/security.md.
